title: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain an Authentication Bypass… (CVE-2026-91896)
description: Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC) versions prior to 6.14.54.0 contain an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows a low privileged local attacker to spoof authentication. Exploitation could lead to information tampering, denial of service, and spoofing of application notifications. The vulnerability has a low CVSS score of 3.9 and requires user interaction.
